description: Deterministic first-pass mapping for Patients.csv. Only mappings supported by the current canonical IML schema are included. Unmapped Easy Care fields remain preserved in iml_legacy.raw_record and are handled in later domain-specific passes.

rules.notes: Create one stable canonical person UUID per Easy Care patient ID; provenance retained in iml_legacy.canonical_link.
Archived -> INACTIVE; otherwise ACTIVE. Death is not inferred from this field.
BIRTH name record; exact source text remains preserved even if tokenization is imperfect.
Used only when the full Prénoms field is empty.
Only explicit source values are mapped; unknown/unrecognized values remain NULL and are reported.
First-pass preservation in canonical address_line1. Structured parsing, if desired, is a later local-only step.
